page.overview:
Who is Eddy Grey?

Eddy Grey was an Illinois state trooper. On October 31, 1989, he, along with the Haddonfield police force and several other troopers, was sent to the Myers house. Sheriff Ben Meeker then told his men to head over towards the Haddonfield Children's Clinic as Jamie Lloyd had felt that her friend Billy Hill was in danger. Eddy stayed behind to take Jamie, Charlie Bloch and Sam Loomis to the police station. As soon as they left, Eddy noticed that another police vehicle was right behind him, and it bumped into Eddy's car. The driver of the vehicle turned out to be Michael Myers, who attacked Eddy and bashed his face against a steering wheel multiple times, killing him.
